summary: Backend + frontend regression for evidence-based reporting upgrade. Added new pytest suite covering normalized fields (quick_assessment, evidence_confidence, possible_damage_mechanism, limitations, required_verification, assessment_status, damage_classification), exact-3 recommendations, insufficient-evidence path, PDF/DOCX/XLSX sections, and image validation. All 11 backend tests passed against live URL. Frontend flow verified end-to-end: form submit -> Evidence & Confidence panel with Observed/Estimated/Unknown lists, mechanism, limitations, required verification, 3 ranked recommendations, PDF download HTTP 200, history navigation renders full result.

issues: Long single-token structure_name (e.g. 'TEST_UI_evidence_beam') in H1 does not break and causes horizontal overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth=562 vs viewport 390). Add word-break: break-word / overflow-wrap: anywhere on .result-header h1.

action_items: Apply overflow-wrap/word-break on results H1 (.result-header h1) so long underscored structure names do not cause horizontal overflow on mobile widths.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: create_assessment returns response_model=Assessment but Assessment schema currently omits 'quick_assessment.key_visible_evidence' item validation and 'possible_damage_mechanism.supporting_evidence' visibility on frontend; frontend EvidencePanel does not surface supporting_evidence though backend populates it — consider showing it or removing to reduce dead data.
server.py is a single ~370-line file with heavy inline PDF/DOCX/XLSX generation; consider splitting exports into a reports module for maintainability.
Frontend App.js is a single dense file with inline styles/logic and JSX minified to one line per component — hurts readability and DRY. Consider splitting components into files.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (minor mobile H1 overflow with long underscored names)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_evidence_detailed, TEST_evidence_minimal, TEST_pdf_report, TEST_docx_report, TEST_xlsx_report, TEST_bad_b64/mime/uniform_img (rejected), TEST_UI_evidence_beam via UI. 43 records in history at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_evidence_reports.py validates normalization (STATUS/CLASSIFICATION/CONFIDENCE/URGENCY enums, percentage int 0-100, list types, exactly 3 recommendations) and export sections (PDF via pypdf, DOCX via python-docx, XLSX via openpyxl). Run with TEST_BASE_URL env var. Mobile 390px is fine for typical structure names; only extremely long unbroken tokens overflow.
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow RCA: .result-header h1 in App.css lacks overflow-wrap/word-break, so tokens without spaces (like TEST_UI_evidence_beam) render at their intrinsic width, expanding the flex container beyond 390px. Fix: add `overflow-wrap: anywhere; word-break: break-word;` to .result-header h1 (and optionally .history-item b).
